subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive with ML/Infra — scheduling and draft agenda
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@innovacorps.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive — proposed slots and draft agenda

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call: Innovacorps is looking to validate latency/throughput for a real-time assistant flow (avg seq len ~120 tokens), understand cost tradeoffs for batching/quantization, and run a short eval on a ~10K prompt set.

Next concrete step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra engineers to walk through an ops runbook, sample traffic pattern testing, and an initial mutual action plan.

Suggested 60–90 min slots (all PDT):
- Tue May 14 — 09:00–10:30
- Wed May 15 — 13:00–14:30
- Thu May 16 — 08:30–10:00

Please tell me which of these works (or paste a few of your team's preferred windows) and who from your side will attend. I CC'd Mateo (infra) so we can confirm appropriate owners and prerequisites.

Draft agenda (attached):
- 5m: introductions and goals
- 15m: recap of discovery & expected workload
- 25–35m: infra deep dive — serving runtime, batching, caching, and fallback policies
- 15–25m: test plan and evaluation (datasets, metrics, token budget)
- 10m: mutual action plan and next steps

Attachments: innovacorps-tdx-agenda-v1.pdf, mvp-inference-profile.xlsx

Notes/questions for you:
- Do you have a preferred dataset or redacted sample prompts we can run during the session?
- Any compliance/region constraints we should account for up front (e.g., EU-only data)?

Best,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0198

Thanks, Rafael — great summary. Wed May 15 13:00–14:30 PDT looks best for our team. Attendees likely: me (product lead), Michael Tran (ML lead) and Priya Shah (platform).

We can share a small redacted prompt set (about 1k prompts) ahead of time — I should be able to upload that by Monday. No special region constraints — US data only.

Couple small asks on the agenda: please include a short section on expected cost sensitivity (rough $/1k tokens estimates for different batching profiles) and an example timeline for a POC footprint.

If you can lock Wed at 13:00 PDT and send a calendar invite with desired owners for the follow-ups, that would be ideal.

—Sarah

- Any prework we need to run (e.g., a short perf profile using their 1k redacted prompts)?

Rafael / Sarah — thanks, confirmed. I (Mateo) will be on the call and will bring Miguel Ortiz (serving runtime engineer). Miguel will take the lead on the perf run and ideally pre-launch a quick prefix/KV cache test during the first 15 minutes of the session.

Prework we need from Innovacorps:
- The 1k redacted prompt set (CSV) you mentioned — upload to the secure share or send a link 24 hours before the session.
- A short note on expected concurrency (typical concurrent sessions) and peak qps — helps tune batching profiles.
- Any IP redaction guidance we should apply before running samples.

Agenda tweaks:
- Add a 10m slot after the infra deep dive to run a micro-profile (live) and show expected p50/p95 for a sample 120-token seq.
- Include a line item for token-cost illustrations (we'll run 2 batch sizes and show $/1k-token estimates).

I've created the calendar invite for Wed May 15, 13:00–14:30 PDT and attached the invite link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd1234. Invite includes resource: TDX Room 2 (virtual).
